title: Detection cue: true positive
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: center-border contrast and peak intensity are higher in nodule windows.
cam_observation: CAM follows a focal high-response hotspot, matching the FEM-guided contrast/amplitude cue.

title: Detection cue: pseudo-hotspot FP
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: the detector is intentionally sensitive to localized contrast.
cam_observation: A non-nodule heterogeneous region creates a nodule-like CAM focus; size/depth readouts can help exclude it.

title: Size cue: large footprint
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: late contrast and temporal hotspot emergence increase with nodule size.
cam_observation: Size CAM covers an extended footprint on the late high-response frame, consistent with morphology-based sizing.

title: Size error: deformed footprint
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: size uses footprint morphology, not only the peak value.
cam_observation: The size CAM follows a broad/deformed response and overcalls an adjacent bin, which fits the deformation failure mode.

title: Depth cue: spread/position
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: hotspot radius and spatial spread weakly increase with depth.
cam_observation: Depth CAM shifts to the peripheral/spread component; this is consistent but weaker than detection and size.

title: Depth error: weak separability
feature_anchor: Feature anchor: depth effects are modest and strongly affected by contact state.
cam_observation: Detection and size remain correct, but depth CAM is shifted/multifocal and predicts middle for a deep target.
